item.name: PUT /panel/devices/{name}/state - Inject hardware control action.

request.description:
Inject hardware control action.

Inject an action for a specific hardware panel control. Currently supports button press actions.

For hardware buttons:
- Default hold duration is 100ms if not specified
- Maximum hold duration is 5000ms
- To release a button immediately, use holdDuration of 0
- To keep holding a button, send a new request before the current hold expires (this will overwrite the previous timer)


Operation ID: `setPanelDeviceState`

Responses: 204: Action performed successfully.; 400: Invalid action, device is disabled, or hold duration exceeds maximum limit.; 404: Device not found.; 500: Internal server error.

Source: `Common/PanelControl.yaml`
